summary: An educational sandbox repository for practicing fundamental web development and algorithmic programming concepts through modular, hands-on exercises.
key_features: Modular directory structure for isolated technical objectives
Interactive JS DOM manipulation (mouse-tracking, event-driven toggling, dynamic generation)
Advanced CSS positioning and layered compositions
Semantic HTML table structures and typography styling
C++ manual digit-by-digit multiplication for large integers
achievements: Implemented manual large-integer arithmetic in C++ using string manipulation to bypass standard integer overflow limitations. Developed interactive DOM features including real-time mouse tracking and dynamic element generation. Engineered complex CSS positioning systems for layered asset placement. Structured a modular, self-contained learning environment with independent modules, local server configurations, and IDE debugging setups.
